LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Alignment_Own()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the current alignment's identification, as picked up by the position tool, plus its direction of increasing mileages shown as three angle brackets. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'OwnAlignment' [AlignmentReference] which is the current Own Alignment picked up by the CAD cursor, plus 'MileageIncreasesTowardsLeft' [Boolean] which tells whether the own alignment's Mileage Increases Towards Left as viewed on the user's computer screen. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Alignment_Own'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Alignment_Own(positionToolInfo) local oa = RC__identify(positionToolInfo.OwnAlignment) if positionToolInfo.OwnMileageIncreasesTowardsLeft then return "OWN: <<< "..oa --prefix own alignment with left angle bracket else return "OWN: "..oa.." >>>" --postfix own alignment with right angle brackets end end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Alignment_Ref()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the current CAD cursor's reference alignment identification corresponding to the current alignment, as picked up by the position tool, plus its direction of increasing mileages shown as three angle brackets. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'RefAlignment' [AlignmentReference] which is the current Reference Alignment picked up by the CAD cursor, plus 'MileageIncreasesTowardsLeft' [Boolean] which tells whether the reference alignment's Mileage Increases Towards Left as viewed on the user's computer screen. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Alignment_Ref'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Alignment_Ref(positionToolInfo) local ra = RC__identify(positionToolInfo.RefAlignment) if positionToolInfo.RefMileageIncreasesTowardsLeft then return "REF: <<< "..ra --prefix reference alignment with left angle bracket else return "REF: "..ra.." >>>" --postfix reference alignment with right angle brackets end end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Distance_Own()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the current CAD cursor's distance from the current alignment, as picked up by the position tool. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'Value' [Double] [m] which is the horizontal Distance (lateral offset) from the CAD cursor to the current Own alignment. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Distance_Own'.

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Elevation_Own()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the vertical profile at the CAD cursor, measured in the current alignment, as picked up by the position tool. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'Value' [Double] [m] being the said measurement. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Elevation_Own'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Elevation_Own(positionToolInfo) local oe = positionToolInfo.Value return oe and string.format("Vertical offset from OWN %.03f",oe) or "Vertical offset from OWN (no data)" end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Elevation_Ref()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the vertical profile at the CAD cursor, measured in the reference alignment corresponding to the current alignment, as picked up by the position tool. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'Value' [Double] being the said measurement. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Elevation_Ref'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Elevation_Ref(positionToolInfo) local re = positionToolInfo.Value return re and string.format("Vertical offset from REF %.03f",re) or "Vertical offset from REF (no data)" end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Mileage_Own()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the chainage ('mileage' in RC, 'Position' in NRV) at the CAD cursor, measured along the current alignment, as picked up by the position tool. This 'own mileage' is the result of an initial start mileage plus the distance along measured from start of alignmment up to the cursor's projection onto it, adjusted by possible chain breaks / mileposts along the own alignment. Mileage information can be inspected and adjusted from the Alignment Manager tool. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'Value' [Double] [m] which is the mileage measured along the applicable Own alignment where the CAD cursor's projection is. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Mileage_Own'.

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Mileage_Ref()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the chainage ('reference mileage' in RC, 'Mileage' in NRV) at the current CAD cursor, measured along the reference alignment corresponding to the current alignment, as picked up by the position tool. The reference mileage is the result of an initial start mileage plus the distance along measured from start of the reference alignmment up to the cursor's projection onto it, adjusted by possible chain breaks / mileposts along the reference alignment. Mileage information can be inspected and adjusted from the Alignment Manager tool. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'Value' [Double] [m] which is the mileage measured along the applicable Reference alignment where the CAD cursor's projection is. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Mileage_Ref'.

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_PositionTransient_Set_Pos_Own()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a formatted string containing the current CAD cursor's reference alignment's DistanceAlong as measured along the current reference alignment, to be displayed by the position tool. The Reference Pos is the distance along the centreline of the reference alignment's horizontal geometry, measured from start position '0' of the reference alignmment up to the cursor's projection onto the horizontal geometry, unaffected by possible chain breaks. Position information can be inspected and adjusted from the Alignment Manager tool. When RC uses the function, then RC provides the required input 'positionToolInfo' which contains 'Value' [Double] [m] which is the Pos measured along the applicable Reference alignment where the CAD cursor's projection is. Note: If this function is not provided to the position tool, then RC will format a suitable default text using the current translation found in the built-in language pack system (ResX) for key 'PositionTransient_Set_Pos_Ref'.
